title: Jobstock
subtitle: A Job Portal Application and Website
description: A full-featured recruitment platform featuring a Flutter mobile app for job seekers and a React web dashboard for employers. Includes automated email notifications, cron-driven candidate updates, resume management, and streamlined applicant filtering for modern hiring workflows.

title: Employee Dashboard
subtitle: An internal HR platform
description: An enterprise HR management platform designed to streamline internal company workflows. Features task assignment, leave management, automated salary slip generation, support ticketing, and role-based dashboards built with the MERN stack, secure JWT authentication, and VPS deployment via GitHub Actions.

title: TEN AI Consulting
subtitle: A Comprehensive Business Website
description: A dynamic business consulting platform built for The Entrepreneurship Network featuring 16 interactive sections and Calendly scheduling. Led frontend architecture, AOS scroll animations, responsive UI design, and performance optimizations to deliver an engaging, high-speed user experience.

title: AI Resume Builder
subtitle: A Dynamic Resume Creation Platform
description: An intelligent resume creation tool powered by Google Gemini AI and the MERN stack. Led backend API design, database schemas, and PDF generation workflows, enabling job seekers to generate, customize, and export ATS-friendly resumes seamlessly in minutes.

title: iNoteBook
subtitle: A secured notebook on cloud
description: A secure cloud note-taking web application built with MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js. Features Bcrypt password hashing, JWT user authentication, timestamped CRUD note operations, and a responsive interface for safe, organized notes accessible from anywhere.

title: Google Currency Converter
subtitle: A clone of Google Currency Converter
description: A lightweight real-time currency conversion tool inspired by Google Currency Converter. Integrates the Open Exchange Rates API to convert between 150+ global currencies with live financial data, instant calculation, and a clean, responsive mobile-friendly interface.

title: Banking Management System
subtitle: A terminal based CRUD App
description: A robust terminal-based banking application built with core Java, Object-Oriented Programming, JDBC, and MySQL. Features secure user authentication, balance inquiries, deposit and withdrawal transactions, and inter-account funds transfers with strict relational database integrity.
